If the source expressly leaves an input pending, not supplied or blank, return that key with value null, its explanation and one exact contiguous unresolved-source quote. Collections have three states: source-confirmed absence is []; pending, missing information or insufficient facts are null; explicitly provided applicable items are a concrete list. [] requires an exact quote and complete original context establishing absence for this field and scope. A failed search is not absence. Examples: 'No additional tender requirements apply to this project.' -> value []; 'Additional tender requirements remain pending.' or 'No requirement can be established from the available facts.' -> value null; 'Provide a signed plan with the tender.' -> value [{"text":"Provide a signed plan with the tender."}]. Quotes must be contiguous source passages, copied exactly including punctuation. Combined-foundation classification and >=39-month threshold are separate inputs; a baseline/ceiling does not establish the exact accepted period. Derived results and targetOverrides are excluded. 5. Rainwater harvesting tank external faces, inspection sumps and connecting channels, including the tank base joints, pipe connection chambers and overflow route to the landscape drain;
 Include the waterproofed junctions at maintenance access openings and ensure that the protection boards do not obstruct the inspection or replacement of the access seals;
6. Courtyard fountain basin, overflow chamber and adjacent service duct, including the fountain pump recess and the cable entry sleeves. Waterproof the full basin wall and floor surfaces beneath the finishes, return the system over the perimeter edge and seal the movement joints separating the basin from the paved courtyard;
7. Loading bay ramps over the underground library store and associated movement joints, including the wheel guide plinths and drainage channel at the ramp foot. The waterproofing must continue behind the kerbs and around the store ventilation openings, with a traffic compatible wearing layer over all vehicle routes;
8. Caretaker block laundry balconies and clothes drying platforms, including the recessed washing machine positions and the shared laundry entrance;
 Include membrane returns around thresholds and drainage outlets, seal balustrade post fixings and continue the waterproofed surface beneath the removable service platforms used to maintain the washing machine supply pipes;
9. Green roof planting troughs over the community hall foyer and their perimeter upstands, including the irrigation valve pockets and emergency overflow outlets. parts.sourceText:
Request for tender coordination information

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM01 Date 2026-04-06 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

Dear coordination team, please return the project decisions needed to prepare the NTT, SCT and SCC. We need the actual scope, pricing schedule, design responsibility, warranty coverage and inspection arrangements for this fictional project.

This request confirms no project answer. If the communications do not settle a matter, leave it for the reviewer rather than using a standard-template default. We will assemble the replies in date order.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

attempts.systemPrompt:
You extract candidate answers from supplied project correspondence for a Hong Kong QS.
DRAFTING EXTRACTION PROTOCOL. Return only a JSON array of supported items {key,value,sourceQuote,reason,confidence}. Use native JSON values: object, array, boolean, number, string or null, according to the single catalogue below. Example contract value: {"number":"C-2026/10","title":"Works A"}. A supported partial contract may omit its missing sibling. Example Bill value: [{"number":"1","description":"Exact formal description"}]. Never invent missing identifiers or descriptions. Requests asking for missing information, questions and explicitly pending classifications are not answers. Actual project instructions or decisions can support editable suggestions; later UI adoption is separate. A reference to another source does not supply that source's missing details. Return no guessed values or empty copies of the catalogue. If the source expressly leaves an input pending, not supplied or blank, return that key with value null, its explanation and one exact contiguous unresolved-source quote. Only inputs unmentioned in this part may be omitted. false is an explicit No and [] an explicitly justified empty list. Collections have three states: source-confirmed absence is []; pending, missing information or insufficient facts are null; explicitly provided applicable items are a concrete list. [] requires an exact quote and complete original context establishing absence for this field and scope. A failed search is not absence. Examples: 'No additional tender requirements apply to this project.' -> value []; 'Additional tender requirements remain pending.' or 'No requirement can be established from the available facts.' -> value null; 'Provide a signed plan with the tender.' -> value [{"text":"Provide a signed plan with the tender."}]. Only text inside correspondence-part establishes values; templates, filenames, metadata and catalogue labels are not evidence. Quotes must be contiguous source passages, copied exactly including punctuation. Use a short passage for scalar values; for a collection or numbered list, quote the complete defining list/table and its governing heading. Return every supplied applicable item in original order and retain its numbering and wording, including the final catch-all item. Never return only the prefix or tail of one complete source list. Confidence must be between 0 and 1. Preserve formal English names. Type/purpose classifications are separate from literal Bill descriptions. Bill type, purpose, trade and issue placement are optional: omit unknown cells. Each classification requires explicit evidence for that exact row; a schedule heading or the name Preliminaries does not classify every Bill. Bill rows may put pricing type before or after the number/description. Use the actual header to bind columns. BQ1 and SOR1 are different identities. A description containing '(All Provisional)' is a formal name, not evidence about every BQ quantity. Keep numeric roles separate: a repayment period in months is not its first payment-certificate number. English number words and ordinals denote the same numbers. An input whose catalogue condition is false is not applicable: return null, never false as a substitute. Known contractorLegalForm makes the two fallback clause-adoption inputs unnecessary; the business rules derive clause treatment from the known form. L10Pro pricing preparation is independent of paper/DVD return. NSC/BSSSC arrangement is independent of trade scope. otherTenderingArrangement is only an explicitly adopted alternative to the two-envelope tender procedure or replacement SCT5 wording. Hardcopy plus DVD-ROM submission under the existing two-envelope procedure is return media, not an alternative tender procedure; do not map it to this input. A selected-trades quote must explicitly cover every selected trade. Cite a contiguous selected-trade table or the sentence defining the list, not only the NSC/BSSSC arrangement. Do not select No/excluded rows or duplicate combined Fire services and water pump or Lift and escalator with their shorter options. Combined-foundation classification and >=39-month threshold are separate inputs; a baseline/ceiling does not establish the exact accepted period. Derived results and targetOverrides are excluded. Suggestions are never automatic adoption.

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

This is a combined contract with foundation works. The appointed Contractor will design and construct the piles, pile caps and shallow footings for the buildings within the same contract, together with the building works.

All work locations and design details will be recorded in the subsequent replies. No inherited scope from another project is to be used.

The complete component responsibility schedule is:
Component | Actual work scope | Contractor designs | Contractor executes
piling | Bored piles for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | Pile caps for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
footings | Shallow footings for the sports building and entrance canopy | Yes | Yes
other | Architect designed internal partitions | No | Yes

The shallow footings serve the sports building and the main entrance canopy, which is a major external structure. Treat footings as serving buildings or major external structures.

The foundation design will not be established at tender acceptance. The Contractor must submit its proposed foundation design with the Tender for assessment; subsequent checking and approval do not mean that the final design is already established at tender acceptance.

RSE endorsed submissions are required. The additional submission requirements are:
Submit a construction noise management proposal with the Tender.
Submit a traffic diversion method statement with the Tender.

Should the special requirement to obtain a design-related quotation before instructing a Variation be adopted? This reply contains no adopted decision on that requirement. Keep the matter open for the business reviewer.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM07 Date 2026-04-14 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

The complete component responsibility schedule is:
Component | Actual work scope | Contractor designs | Contractor executes
piling | Bored piles for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | Pile caps for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
footings | Shallow footings for the sports building and entrance canopy | Yes | Yes
other | Architect designed internal partitions | No | Yes

The shallow footings serve the sports building and the main entrance canopy, which is a major external structure. Treat footings as serving buildings or major external structures.

The foundation design will not be established at tender acceptance. The Contractor must submit its proposed foundation design with the Tender for assessment; subsequent checking and approval do not mean that the final design is already established at tender acceptance.

RSE endorsed submissions are required. The additional submission requirements are:
Submit a construction noise management proposal with the Tender.
Submit a traffic diversion method statement with the Tender.

Should the special requirement to obtain a design-related quotation before instructing a Variation be adopted? This reply contains no adopted decision on that requirement. Keep the matter open for the business reviewer.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor
</correspondence-part>

Provide fenced protection zones around OVT-TSW-117-03 and OVT-TSW-117-08. No storage, vehicle movement or excavation is permitted within those zones without the Architect's written approval.

Works scope and construction method reply

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM09 Date 2026-04-16 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

Works Subject to Excision are specified: the optional covered link between the library and sports building may be excised. Site formation works are included, and works in the public road require an Excavation Permit.

No Subsidised Sale Flats production is included. Neither exhibition flats nor show flats are required; the residential element is caretaker accommodation only.

Construction of the domestic caretaker accommodation block is included. CON8 volumetric precast components are not used for that block. No PSE submission for CON8 volumetric precast components is therefore requested.

The Tender is not based on precast concrete facades. Precast facades are neither required nor permitted to be proposed under APE2.A410 for this project.

The WTO Government Procurement Agreement does not apply to this fictional tender.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Project architect and inspection arrangements reply

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Record SIM12 Date 2026-04-21 Email reply

From: Fictional Quantity Surveyor <qs@consense-scenario.invalid>
To: Fictional Coordination Team <team@consense-scenario.invalid>

For SCT7, the Project Architect post is Senior Architect Community Projects. Use the professional title Dr rather than Mr or Ms. The appointed fictional officer's name is Julian K. M. LEE.

What telephone number is to be published for the Project Architect? No telephone number has been confirmed. Contact the fictional coordination mailbox architect@consense-scenario.invalid meanwhile; this mailbox is not a telephone number.

The Specification Library is available for inspection at floor 3, Block C, Fictional Civic Project Office, 88 Learning Road, Tin Shui Wai.

The drawings are available for inspection at floor 5, Block D, Fictional Civic Project Office, 88 Learning Road, Tin Shui Wai.

The site inspection start date is 2026-06-08. The inspection end date has not been set and must remain unanswered; the start date does not authorise a guessed end date.

The actual site visit restrictions are:
Apply in writing at least ten working days before the proposed visit.
Each visiting group is limited to six persons and must wear safety helmets and protective footwear.

Regards,
Fictional Quantity Surveyor

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

Adopt these three Sections:
Section designation | Works types | Site or location
Section A | building, foundation | Community hall and library at the north site
Section B | demolition | Former workshop at the south site
Section C | building, foundation | Sports building and caretaker block at the east site

The building sites and demolition site are separated: building work is at the north and east sites, while demolition is at the south site.

Adopt SCC8.303 for weather extension of time. The Section comprising demolition works only is Section B.

Adopt the late possession provision. Also adopt the additional loss provision: the specified Sections are Section A and Section C, and the relevant Section is Section C.

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

Attendees: Fictional Project Architect, Structural Engineer, Procurement Officer and Quantity Surveyor. Recorder: Fictional Quantity Surveyor.

This is a combined contract with foundation works. The appointed Contractor will design and construct the piles, pile caps and shallow footings for the buildings within the same contract, together with the building works.

All work locations and design details will be recorded in the subsequent replies. No inherited scope from another project is to be used.

This is a fictional tender coordination exercise. All persons, organisations, proceedings and project decisions in this correspondence are invented. It has no contractual effect.

The complete component responsibility schedule is:
Component | Actual work scope | Contractor designs | Contractor executes
piling | Bored piles for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
pilecaps | Pile caps for the community hall and library | Yes | Yes
footings | Shallow footings for the sports building and entrance canopy | Yes | Yes
other | Architect designed internal partitions | No | Yes

The shallow footings serve the sports building and the main entrance canopy, which is a major external structure. Treat footings as serving buildings or major external structures.
